Theta228Broad.replay : ∀ (n : ℕ) {δ : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    ∀ {r q : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ},
      1 ≤ ↑(r (Fin.last n)) →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), ↑(r i.succ) ≤ δ * ↑(r i.castSucc)) →
          (↑n + 1) * (2 * (↑n + 1) + 1) / δ ≤ Real.log ↑(q 0) →
            (∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) →
              Theta228Broad.Θ (↑(q 0) ^ (δ * ↑(r 0))) q r < 10 ^ (n + 1) * δ ^ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1)
